title: P3 inbox_read: response
description: A data block with entries and the number of hidden ones: entries with a mark above the task's mark are not given out, their number comes in the hidden field (MSG-6). The answer goes to the model as a tool output block in the untrusted text wrapper (INJ-4). The entries given out are leased by the attempt and are acknowledged by its complete (MSG-9).

hidden.description: How many entries above the task's mark were not given out.
